nodes.label: Computer-Based Exam Application (CBT)
nodes.rationale: Built as a computer-based testing application intended for school exam types PTS (Penilaian Tengah Semester), PAS (Penilaian Akhir Semester), and USP (Ujian Satuan Pendidikan).

nodes.label: PHP JSON and ZIP Extension Requirement
nodes.rationale: Deployment on shared hosting requires enabling the PHP JSON and ZIP extensions, presumably because the application serializes data as JSON and imports/exports archives.
nodes.norm_label: php json and zip extension requirement

nodes.label: config 404 Error Page
nodes.rationale: Custom 404 page placed in config/ to guard the configuration directory from direct browsing; includes a home link to 'x' and an Islamic quote, reflecting the app's Indonesian Islamic-school context.

nodes.label: HttpErrorPages Template (AndiDittrich)
nodes.author: Andi Dittrich
nodes.rationale: MIT-licensed static error-page template reused to avoid building custom error-page styling; Indonesian humorous copy was layered on top.

nodes.label: CANDY 2.8 Release Credits
nodes.rationale: Release history marker for 'CANDY 2.8', crediting Allah SWT, the developer's daughter Nasha, and all members of the Candy project — indicating the codebase lineage/brand is Candy.

nodes.label: mod_user 404 Error Page
nodes.rationale: Guards the mod_user module directory from direct access; uses the Stisla admin template and a colloquial Indonesian message ('Halaman nggak ada mas bro') for consistency with the app's tone.

nodes.label: Stisla Admin Template
nodes.rationale: Chosen as a ready-made Bootstrap/HTML admin and error-page template (assets/modules/bootstrap, fontawesome) to standardize panel styling.

nodes.label: Candy PPDB 2020
nodes.rationale: Footer copyright marks this codebase as descended from the 2020 'Candy PPDB' (new-student admission) project, later adapted for computer-based exams.

nodes.label: White Surface Texture
nodes.rationale: 256x256 near-white, very low-contrast JPEG showing a faint irregular fibrous/veined surface (paper/canvas-like), saved from Google per Exif. Its uniform, tileable look suggests it is intended as a subtle background texture for the x-panel admin UI, but no PHP, CSS, or HTML file in the repository references 'acs.jpg', so actual usage is unconfirmed.
